question: What purpose is served by the offering prescribed on the sixth day in this sequence?
premises: An offering is prescribed on the sixth day.
Viṣṇu is named in relation to the offering.
The purpose is the increase of satisfaction.
inference: On the sixth day, an offering should be given to increase the satisfaction of Viṣṇu.
plain_english: On the sixth day, an offering should be given to increase the satisfaction of Viṣṇu.
